test_QwenImageInpaintPipeline_inference: test the QwenImageInpaintPipeline by running inference with a prompt, image, and mask to generate an inpainted image
test_QwenImageInpaintPipeline_attention_: test the QwenImageInpaintPipeline attention slicing feature by comparing outputs with and without slicing enabled
test_QwenImageInpaintPipeline_vae_tiling: test the QwenImageInpaintPipeline VAE tiling feature by comparing outputs with and without tiling enabled
test_QwenImageInpaintPipeline_true_cfg: test the QwenImageInpaintPipeline true CFG feature by encoding prompts and running inference with true_cfg_scale
test_QwenImageInpaintPipeline_batch_infe: test the QwenImageInpaintPipeline batch inference by generating multiple identical images and comparing outputs
